brief: Dispenser drawer (top-left): compartments I, II, and softener; main-wash detergent goes in compartment II (the largest, left).
Program selector dial (top): positions include Cottons, Synthetics, Delicates, Spin.
Temp key cycles 20 → 40 → 60 °C; current value on the display.
Start/Pause key: press and hold ~2 s until the indicator illuminates.

verify.prompt: Is the machine's program dial pointing at 'Cottons'? Answer yes/no/unclear.
verify.sayOnYes: I can see it's on Cottons. Good.
